decisive_items: Thin-walled, irregularly branched blood vessels dispersed between thickened collagen bundles
Endothelial cells were plump but displayed no significant cytologic atypia
response.rationale: The vascular proliferation with plump endothelial cells, low Ki-67, and negative HHV-8/D2-40 favors a benign vascular process; among the supplied options, R1 is the closest match, whereas R3 is contradicted by negative HHV-8/D2-40 and R2 by absent extracutaneous involvement and incompatible histology.

rejected.why: Kaposi's sarcoma is strongly contradicted by negative HHV-8 and D2-40 immunohistochemistry.
Kimura disease is unsupported by the lack of extracutaneous involvement and the absence of eosinophilic/lymphoid histologic features.
